title: Fine-tune depth: judge the thigh the way it looks

log.text: After the last fix he stops near parallel, a few degrees high, and the depth check passes. But the measure still has a small bias: his standing thighs naturally lean back about 4°, so poses that look most like the coach read a little too deep. Calibrating the thigh from how it looks standing, then aiming at the coach's depth exactly.

Started: the thigh and shin will be counted from how their skin looks in the standing pose (about 6° off the joints, not 10.6°), and the squat will hold its bottom at the coach's depth. Measuring the skin outline of each leg in the standing pose first.

Measured each leg's skin outline in the standing pose: the thighs lean back 4.5° (right) / 5.0° (left) where their joint lines lean 10.5° / 10.8°; MediaPipe on the standing render agrees (hip 171.9, ~4° back). The shin's own outline is all knee and heel, so the shin turns with the thigh and the knee keeps its joint reading (MediaPipe: 178.4, straight). Built and tested in a scratch copy; running a full scratch animation now.

Scratch run with the new count and the depth held at the coach's −0.05: every row as before or better (depth −0.047 pass, middle knee 105.7 vs coach 104.7; 20 pass / 5 fail / 4 uncertain), the standing pose reads hip 175.2 (MediaPipe on the same render: 171.8 with a 4° lean). But beside 17.png the bottom now looks a little above parallel — the thigh slopes down to the knee where the coach's is level. Checking a variant before closing.

Compared two versions beside 17.png at the same thigh length: holding the bottom at the coach's −0.05 by the new count leaves the hips visibly above the knees (thigh outline 7° downhill, the coach's level); letting it sit where the depth check's margin stops it (+0.03, still a pass) puts the thigh level like the coach's. The coach's −0.05 is his MediaPipe line, which runs ~4° below his visible thigh. Going with the level-looking one and flagging it for review.

Applied (8 files, backed up as .bak-20b) while the Studio was idle: the thigh is counted from its skin outline in the Studio and the solver, and the clip-less key-position path counts the legs the same way. Running the tests and a final scratch run from the real code.

Verified from the real code: standing reads hip 175.2 (MediaPipe on the same render 172.0 with a 4° lean; on a person-shaped test human the two agree within 0.3°); bottom depth +0.03 (pass) with the thigh level like the coach's; middle knee 104.9 vs the coach's 104.7; 20 pass / 5 fail / 4 uncertain. All tests pass (the clip-less test squat's hip reads 90.3). Holding the number at exactly −0.05 was built and tested too, but it left the hips visibly above the knees, so it is not switched on — flagged for review.

summary: The thigh is now judged by its skin outline (how it looks), in the Studio and the animation alike. The bottom's thigh sits level like the coach's (depth +0.03, pass); 20 pass / 5 fail / 4 uncertain. Holding the depth at exactly the coach's −0.05 made the hips sit visibly above the knees, so that part is left off pending review.
